# DMLOGISTIC

Another name for LOGISTIC REGRESSION.

## Syntax

```text
DMLOGISTIC dependent WITH covariates [/subcommands of LOGISTIC REGRESSION].
```

The same command as LOGISTIC REGRESSION, with the same subcommands and defaults.

## Example

```text
DMLOGISTIC bought WITH age tenure /PRINT=SUMMARY.
```

`statscraft help DMLOGISTIC` prints the same text in the terminal. [All commands](README.md)
